metadata.name: perf-drag-vertical-pointer
metadata.description: Perf interaction helper: drag a target VERTICALLY with real PointerEvents (pointerdown -> rAF-stepped pointermove -> pointerup), one move per animation frame. Use it for swipe-to-dismiss grabbers and any gesture built on pointer events - the MouseEvent-based perf-drag-horizontal helper does not drive them at all. Stepping on rAF is what makes each frame's cost show up separately in the trace instead of collapsing into one task.

labels.parameters_json: [{"name":"selector","type":"string","required":true,"description":"CSS selector of the drag handle (use a literal [data-testid=...]; @selector tokens do not resolve on the capture path)"},{"name":"dy","type":"number","required":false,"default":240,"description":"Vertical drag distance in pixels (positive drags downward)"},{"name":"steps","type":"number","required":false,"default":40,"description":"Number of intermediate pointer moves, one per animation frame"},{"name":"release","type":"string","required":false,"default":"commit","description":"'commit' ends with pointerup (the surface dismisses); 'hold' skips pointerup so the drag frames are traced without the surface unmounting"}]

evaluate.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector("${@params/selector}"); if (!el) throw new Error('perf-drag-vertical-pointer: ${@params/selector} not found'); const dy = Number("${@params/dy}") || 240; const steps = Math.max(1, Number("${@params/steps}") || 40); const release = "${@params/release}" === 'hold' ? 'hold' : 'commit'; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = r.left + r.width / 2; const y0 = r.top + r.height / 2; const fire = (type, y, buttons) => el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent(type, { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true, clientX: x, clientY: y, pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'touch', isPrimary: true, button: buttons ? 0 : -1, buttons: buttons })); const frame = () => new Promise((resolve) => requestAnimationFrame(() => resolve())); return (async () => { fire('pointerdown', y0, 1); await frame(); for (let i = 1; i <= steps; i++) { fire('pointermove', y0 + (dy * i) / steps, 1); await frame(); } if (release === 'commit') { fire('pointerup', y0 + dy, 0); await frame(); } return true; })(); })()
